problems.problem: Original-background remnant flakes left on the silhouette
problems.evidence: Yellow-orange chip beside the label's left edge and a gray sliver along the neck/label contour in the full frame and the baseline label crop of the detail sheet
problems.root_cause: Source cutout matte included fragments of the original photograph background
problems.repair: Clip the alpha matte inward 1-2 px along the label and neck contour and repaint only the remnant flakes, preserving genuine glass edge pixels

problems.problem: Contact shadow is tight and slightly abrupt at the base
problems.evidence: Baseline contact crop shows a dark occlusion hugging the green base with a hardish falloff into the cloth weave
problems.root_cause: Compositor contact shadow used a small blur radius relative to the diffuse frontal light
problems.repair: Re-render the contact occlusion with a wider, lower-opacity elliptical falloff matched to the cloth albedo

problems.problem: Contact occlusion under the base is too weak
problems.evidence: Authoritative contact crop for A: cloth directly beneath the green base reads nearly as bright as surrounding cloth, only a hairline darkening; bottle floats slightly versus baseline
problems.root_cause: Linear-light RGBA pass applied the contact shadow at too low opacity / too wide a spread
problems.repair: Increase contact-shadow core opacity and tighten its radius under the base while keeping the soft diffuse character

problems.problem: Base green glass reads oversaturated versus packshot
problems.evidence: A contact crop shows a brighter, more chromatic green band than the baseline and the flattened source (image 5)
problems.root_cause: Linear-light un-premultiply boosted saturated edge alpha pixels
problems.repair: Clamp saturation on the bottom glass band to the source flattened reference values

problems.problem: Minor halo along the neck contour
problems.evidence: B neck crop shows a faint light fringe against the gray backdrop at the upper neck
problems.root_cause: Alpha edge not defringed against the new neutral backdrop
problems.repair: Apply a 1 px edge-color decontamination using backdrop color on the neck contour only

problems.problem: Weakest floor contact of all versions
problems.evidence: C contact crop: almost no darkening under the green base; cloth weave continues at full brightness beneath the bottle
problems.root_cause: Contact shadow omitted or rendered at negligible opacity in the linear-light pass
problems.repair: Add a soft elliptical contact occlusion consistent with the diffuse frontal light, verified against the baseline crop density

problems.problem: Liquid line and foam ring slightly attenuated in the neck
problems.evidence: C neck crop shows the foam ring paler and the liquid meniscus less defined than baseline and source flatten
problems.root_cause: Tone mapping of the neck region compressed highlight contrast
problems.repair: Restore neck region contrast to match the flattened source (image 5) foam ring density

reason: B keeps full product fidelity (label texture, liquid level, cap and glass transmission identical to the flattened source), removes the baseline's original-background flakes, matches the diffuse frontal packshot light without inventing a hard beam, and its authoritative contact crop still shows a real soft occlusion under the base. A and C lose grounding (contact shadow too weak) and C attenuates the foam ring; baseline retains visible source remnant flakes and a harsher contact edge. B's only defect is a minor neck halo, already within tolerance.

next_repairs.action: Defringe the 1 px light halo against the gray backdrop without touching genuine glass highlights
Optionally deepen the contact core by ~5-8% opacity to sit between baseline density and current B, keeping the diffuse soft edge
